name: nabh.cloud
description: Indian prepaid API with a free monthly GPT-OSS allowance.
overview: The Free plan offers 50 credits on signup and 50 more on the first of each month, each worth INR 1, usable for GPT OSS 20B only. It advertises 5 requests/minute and 500/day. The Developer plan requires a recharge but is not needed for the free plan. Free-credit rollover is not clear. No account or billing was tested.
free_access: 50 INR credits on signup and monthly
notes: Base URL https://api.nabh.cloud/v1. Credits are currency-denominated, not tokens; per-request rounding applies.
